name: app-frosted-blue-grey-user-persona-with-insight-charts
title: Frosted Blue-Grey Persona with Insight Charts
whatItIs: A misty blue-grey slide titled User Persona with a large portrait card of a marketing manager, a quote, three frosted cards for goals, pain points and needs, and three insight cards with striped green bar charts and percentage bubbles.
whatItMeans: Frosted layers over a soft photo feel calm and premium, and green striped bars add a small live accent.
techniques: Frosted glass cards over a blurred background
Portrait card with name overlay and blurred base
Green striped bars as the only saturated colour
Bullet lists in light small type

vocabulary.definition: A card with a chart and a short finding.
A small pill showing a value above a chart.
